channel.title: FAU Cyber Security Club
channel.description: 👋 Welcome to the FAU Cyber Security Club Wiki! Meeting information Weekly Meetings: Thursdays 5 PM - 7 PM Location: CM22 Contact Email: csc@fau.edu This wiki is currently underconstruction. If you would like to help me with it, contact me @solitude_freak or @shaamad on the Discord.

item.title: Introduction
item.description: This Wiki is where you can find quick information about the club and current events, as well as helpful resources and guides to help you get initalized. We strongly encourage an open environment of learning, so NEVER be afraid to ask questions. It is ok if you don’t know something, remember that we are all learning. And the best way to learn is to fail!

item.title: Resources
item.description: This is where you come to find things. Tools, learning material, reference guides — the good stuff that actually helps when you sit down and try to do something real. Here is the honest truth though: nobody is going to hand it to you, and that is fine. The resources here exist to point you in a direction, but whether you actually go anywhere is entirely up to you and what you do with your own time. The people who really get good at this are the ones who go home and keep going. Meetings are a starting point, not the whole picture.

item.title: Past Competitions
item.description: A record of competitions and events the club has participated in, along with the repos and write-ups from each one. These are worth browsing. Seeing how past members approached a challenge — what they built, how they structured it, what worked — is genuinely useful if you are gearing up for your own run.

item.title: Authoring
